messages:
leo-sales: Live POC with Nimbus is getting 429s and UX jitter during the demo. They said errors spike whenever they run a 50-user chat stress test + embeddings sync. Need help triaging quickly.

mina-se: Can you grab a sample response and the console counters? Is this a 429 token-budget hit or a per-route throttle?

leo-sales: Customer log (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-21T16:12:02Z] 429 POST /v1/chat req=nx_001 client=nimbus-poc
Headers: Retry-After: 2, X-RateLimit-Type: global, X-Route-Name: chat
Body: {"error":"rate limit exceeded","quota_remaining":0,"token_budget_remaining":1200}
[2026-03-21T16:12:04Z] 429 POST /v1/embeddings req=nx_002 client=nimbus-poc
Headers: Retry-After: 1, X-RateLimit-Type: per-route, X-Route-Name: embeddings.batch
Body: {"error":"rate limit exceeded","quota_remaining":0}
```

ryan-eng: Interesting: chat shows global rate-type but token_budget still >0. That suggests global request window is saturated before token accounting triggers. Embeddings are hitting per-route caps.

clare-support: I pulled their account from the console: account=nimbus-poc-99 (trial). Defaults: global_rpm=150, chat_rpm=50, embeddings_rpm=25, daily_token_budget=200000. Their stress test is ~1000 req/min across routes because of concurrent websockets + batched embedding jobs.

mina-se: For an immediate fix: (A) enable smoothing on global burst window (reduces peak throughput but avoids sharp 429s), (B) apply a 3-hour temporary uplift: chat_rpm->250, embeddings_rpm->100, token_budget->1M, (C) set fallback model to tiny-chat-v0 for streaming sessions during demo. Do we have approval from sales to push a temporary uplift?

leo-sales: They asked for the least friction approach. Approve the 3-hour uplift now. Also asking about how pricing would look if they sustain this traffic for 1 week.

ops-bot: ACTION: quota-adjust executed by clare-support for account nimbus-poc-99. change_id=chg_20260321_042 TTL=3h. chat_rpm=250, embeddings_rpm=100, token_budget_daily=1000000, smoothing=enabled, fallback_model=tiny-chat-v0.

ryan-eng: Note for infra: investigate why global window blocks before token budget when tokens still exist. Filing ticket INF-814. Might be a mismatched evaluation order in the rate pipeline. Also check that embeddings batch size is accounted correctly when uploaded via their batching client.

security-bot: NOTE: Nimbus submitted a short security questionnaire. They asked about data retention during POC and if logs contain customer messages. Answer: POC telemetry redacts full user messages by default but we can enable strict redaction for trial tenants. They want an SOC FAQ for demos.

mina-se: Follow-ups for sales collateral: (1) create a "-demo-safe patterns" doc: recommend <=4 concurrent chat sockets per demo VM, stagger embeddings jobs, and prefer streaming with a small fallback model; (2) add a pricing estimate table for burst-heavy POC (include sample monthly cost for 1M tokens/day sustained); (3) create an opt-in trial uplift workflow sales can request in-console with auto TTLs. I'll prepare drafts.

leo-sales: Please include a short blurb on security redaction options so I can answer the customer instantly. Also schedule a 20m handoff with Nimbus engineering to review backoff best practices.

clare-support: Customer reported immediate improvement after the uplift and smoothing. They still want a permanent plan for predictable performance. Suggest we propose a Dedicated pilot for them during procurement.

mina-se: I'll add a sample retry snippet (exponential backoff + respect Retry-After) to the demo doc and a checklist for SEs to reduce POC flakiness.

leo-sales: Thanks all — closing this thread once I confirm Nimbus got the note about the Dedicated pilot.
